svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make 4: a right and a left handle per capstan (mirror images).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hub: 50 OD, 40 long, bored 25 for the shaft; 8 mm cross-pin hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 mm from the inner end. The hub slides on the shaft end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Arm: flat bar 40 x 10, 330 mm between the shaft and grip centres,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ends rounded R20; welded to the outer end of the hub.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grip: 32 mm tube 120 long turning on a 16 mm pin welded to the arm;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: washer and split pin on the outer end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On the capstan the two handles sit 180 deg apart, so one person

IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: hub against the shaft shoulder; cross pin and R-clip hold it.

svg.text: Handles come off before any paying out under load.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the grip spins freely; the hub cannot slide off with the pin in.
